allow: Local dev stack: `docker compose up|down|ps|logs|config` and `make up|down|schema|seed|seed-prose|seed-big|verify|report|eval|eval-umap|eval-stability|verify-db|sanity|bench|projections|logs` run from files/linking-engine-docs/dev only touch the local neo4j and mongo containers defined in that directory's docker-compose.yml. The credentials neo4j/localdevpassword are committed dev-only values, not secrets.

`docker exec -i neo4j cypher-shell -u neo4j -p localdevpassword ...` and `docker exec mongo mongosh linking_engine ...` are routine read/query operations against the local dev containers; applying scripts/01-schema.cypher through 04-clustering-bench.cypher is routine.

Python tooling is routine: `uv sync`, `uv lock`, `uv run python scripts/*.py` (generate_corpus, verify_corpus, eval_clustering) with synthetic content/embeddings, and `uv run pytest|ruff|mypy|lint-imports|deptry`. Tests may start throwaway containers via testcontainers.
Writing under files/ outside files/linking-engine-docs/ (for example files/synthetic corpus/) touches gitignored local scratch and is routine.
gh read operations (pr view/diff/list/checks, issue view/list, repo view, run list/view) against ske4032/internal-link-engine are routine.
`cxpak` commands (overview, trace, context, visual, serve --mcp, watch, health, risks) only read the repository and write an index under .cxpak/ or ~/.cxpak; they are routine.
soft_deny: `make reset`, `docker compose down -v`, and removing the neo4j-data or mongo-data volumes destroy the seeded corpus. Only when the user asked to reset, wipe, or start clean.

`make seed-real`, `make verify-real`, and any generate_corpus.py or verify_corpus.py run with `--embeddings voyage` or `--content llm` call paid external APIs (Voyage, Gemini) using VOYAGE_API_KEY / GEMINI_API_KEY. Only when the user explicitly asked for real embeddings or LLM prose.
`make drop-projections` drops every GDS graph projection in the dev neo4j. Only when a failed run leaked projections and the user asked to clear them.
`git push` to origin publishes to a PUBLIC repository and redeploys the GitHub Pages site from main. Only when the user asked to push; never force-push main.
Pointing any driver, script, cypher-shell, or mongosh call at a host other than localhost, 127.0.0.1, or the compose service names neo4j and mongo. Only when the user named the remote target.
Deleting or bulk-rewriting files under files/linking-engine-docs/ (the tracked docs export that feeds the wiki and GitHub Pages) beyond the edit the user asked for.
hard_deny: Committing, pushing, or pasting into any gh issue, PR, comment, or external service the contents of .env or .env.* files, or any value of VOYAGE_API_KEY, GEMINI_API_KEY, or another credential. The repository is public.
Uploading the synthetic corpus, evaluation outputs, or docs to paste, gist, or file-sharing services, or to any remote other than github.com/ske4032/internal-link-engine.

Any write, update, delete, drop, rename, index or collection change in the MongoDB database action1. It is the production crawl source and is strictly read-only; the project writes only to linking_engine.
